race.comment: RICALLEN (3) brings the most reliable recent form, having run second in a BM60 at Mt Isa after winning a BM58 there by just over two lengths. He has a solid 1200m profile, is coming back from stronger grades into this BM55, and the 1.5kg claim adds to a well-rounded winning case. DOITLIKEMAXWELL (8) resumes after a two-month freshening and has the provincial Kilcoy third to Calvary as a strong reference for this, particularly as that form now eases back to a country BM55. Sure to be in the finish again. TOUGH JUDGE (10) was plain behind ROWDASH last start, yet his prior neck second to BOSS BANDIT in Class 4 grade and his one win and one placing from three tries at this track and distance make him a genuine rebound hope. MEGAPHONE MISS (14) was below her best in a BM50 at Kumbia, but her Cunnamulla Mdn win two back and return to a distance where she has already won give her a much better platform. SERAPHINE (11) is not to be discounted.
